method: Inspected official metadata-linked vintage image and compared the camel rider in enlarged CARDROSS with the historical Silk Road logo. The vintage URL currently serves The Release; it does not prove earlier artwork. Logo image identifies an independent common source.

decisions.reason: The small green camel rider in CARDROSS matches the Silk Road marketplace logo, including full animal, rider and linework, rather than the different painted camel/rider in current ROSSCARD. Both concern Ross Ulbricht, but no specific reuse of ROSSCARD is established.

resolved_followups.resolution: Rejected: common external Silk Road logo identified, no demonstrated card-to-card derivation.
